caption: The video captures a clear glass sphere resting on wet rounded pebbles at a calm water's edge under a sunset sky. The sun sits low above distant land, casting a vertical golden glare across the water. Thin orange-pink clouds fill the sky, while the sphere remains fixed in the foreground. Inside it, an inverted horizon and a bright sun streak are visible. Gentle water moves over pebbles on the right, spreading a smooth sheet and then receding to reveal stones. The sun’s reflection column shimmers as the surface ripples. The bright focused streak within the sphere shifts slightly in intensity, matching the changing water surface rather than any movement of the sphere. The horizon, sky, and foreground arrangement stay essentially unchanged across the view.
